verdict.rationale: Mercury is a banking/fintech platform, not an AI agent or assistant host; its AI-native positioning is as an MCP *server* (mcp.mercury.com) that other agents connect to, not as a client/host that plugs in third-party MCP servers to gain their tools. There is no evidence of any Mercury interface (chat, agent, orchestrator) into which external MCP servers can be registered — the natural and only role evidenced is the reverse direction, so this client-side axis is a category error for this product.
